description: Explore and specify systems with OpenSpec, then deliver bounded work orders through the Foundry workflow.

defaultPrompt: Use foundry-explore to clarify my system requirements.
Use foundry-propose to create a system proposal.
Use foundry-start to execute my prepared OpenSpec change.
interface.longDescription: Twelve Foundry execution and role skills, twelve official OpenSpec planning skills, and the OpenSpec–Foundry adapter. AI.Contract owns live contracts, attempts, QA and completion; GitHub records final history. Execution requires a verified service connection, scoped actors and runtime adapters. This skills-only plugin creates no machine connection, credentials, scheduler or deployment.

name: foundry-openspec
